project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions with withAuth() higher-order logic for atomic mutations + Zod + Audit Logs

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, contract_items, customers, leads, employees, audit_logs, services, service_categories, service_bundles. Support: printing_orders, inventory_reservations, inventory_items, contract_notes, transaction_categories, studio_info, labs.
database_schema.strategy: ABC Framework — Group A (Keep ENUM), Group B (Rollback to VARCHAR+TS), Group C (Lookup Table)

new_tables.name: service_bundles
new_tables.description: Mapping for complex services containing other services

design_system.description: Earth-tone luxury palette — Stripe-inspired, Apple HIG compliant

components.TableSuite: TableWrapper, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD (Gold Standard table parts)
components.EmptyState: UxState with icon, title, description, and optional action
components.SelectPill: Chip-based selection for categories and filters
components.ServiceTable: Extended TableSuite with expandable row detail pattern
components.ServiceMobileList: Compact row list with active expand state
components.ServiceGrid: Responsive card layout with hover action overlays

patterns.name: Expandable Table Row Pattern
patterns.details: Toggle state (null | id) to show full description block inside <tr> without breaking TableSuite columns.

patterns.name: VARCHAR + TS Enum Pattern (Group B)
patterns.details: DB: VARCHAR(N) | TS: const array + type [X] | Zod: z.enum() | SSOT map for labels

gotchas: calculateServiceStats MUST be a pure function in utils/ to avoid Next.js Build error 'Server Actions must be async'.
Service category manager should refresh state without hard page reload (Optimistic UI pending Phase 1c).
Mobile FAB button: fixed/z-40 to stay above all content except Modals.
